question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Proceed
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Withdraw'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Proceed"** means to begin or continue a course of action.(आगे बढ़ना)
 
• The word that is opposite in meaning to **"Proceed"** is: **'Withdraw'.**
 
• **"Withdraw"** means to stop participating in an activity or to remove from a place. (वापस लेना)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Withdraw'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Accidental:** This refers to something happening by chance, unexpectedly, or unintentionally. (आकस्मिक)
 
• **Local: **This refers to something that belongs to a particular area or neighborhood.(स्थानीय)
 
• **Wide:** This term refers to something having a great extent from side to side. (चौड़ा)
